gloss: forcibly, by force, against one's will

definitions.gloss: forcibly, by force, against one's will
definitions.explanation: Doing something by force or compulsion, without regard for objections, difficulty, or resistance.

examples.japanese: {無理|むり}やり⟦{食|た}べさせた→食べる：00396_taberu⟧。
{無理|むり}やり⟦ドア→ドア：00773_doa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{開|あ}けた→開ける：00563_akeru⟧。
⟦{嫌|いや}がっている→嫌がる：03041_iyagaru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{無理|むり}やり⟦{参加|さんか}させる→参加する：25408_sankasuru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦よくない→いい：00118_ii⟧。
examples.english: It's not good to force someone to participate when they don't want to.

notes:
WRITING:
Also written as {無理矢理|むりやり}. The hiragana-kanji mix {無理|むり}やり is more common in everyday writing.

FORMS:
⟦{無理|むり}→無理：01558_muri⟧ (unreasonable) + ⟦やり→やる：02980_yaru⟧ (doing). Literally "doing something unreasonable."

USAGE:
Always carries a negative connotation of using excessive force or ignoring resistance. Stronger than ⟦{強引|ごういん}→強引：04156_gouin⟧ (pushy).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {無理|むり}やり⟦{連|つ}れていく→連れていく：23753_tsureteiku⟧: to drag someone along
- {無理|むり}やり⟦{押|お}し{込|こ}む→押し込む：04237_oshikomu⟧: to cram in forcefully
- {無理|むり}やり⟦やらせる→やる：02980_yaru⟧: to force someone to do it
- {無理|むり}やり⟦{笑|わら}う→笑う：00685_warau⟧: to force a smile
